name: ipod
title: iPod
description: iTunes 2 on brushed metal as the desktop's resident iPod: a synthesised library and three stations, transport, volume, search, source list, shuffle and repeat on iTunes 4's foot buttons, and a visualiser that plays each song in its own tone. Pass it to the Desktop as `ipod={IPod}`.
